title: Free-coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\\subseteq\\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $x\\in\\{\\pm1\\}^n$. The free part of $x$ on $J$ is the assignment on $J$ given by $j\\mapsto x_j$.
